identified_issues: Privilege escalation caused by unioning disjoint permissions across operational contexts
Quotient stage erasure collapsing distinct session semantics into a shared coarse authorization context
Violation of the principle of least privilege allowing interactive operators to execute unapproved mutations
evidence: Compression middleware maps Workflow A and Workflow B to a shared 'AUTHORIZED_USER_SESSION' with 'combined_permissions'
An interactive operator in Workflow A successfully executed 'EXECUTE_MUTATION' despite the action being absent from Workflow A's permitted actions
recommended_action: Eliminate the coarse quotient mapping; restore distinct session representations and evaluate authorization requests strictly against workflow-specific permission boundaries.
